limitations: Configured concurrency caps simultaneous API requests; peakInFlight records the level actually reached. Neither is a count of visitors.
One external test location and short sample; no browser rendering, geographic distribution, long soak, or 1,000-daily-user capacity guarantee.
Normal cache behavior is preserved. CDN hits do not measure Supabase origin capacity, and no cache is flushed or bypassed.
Response wire bytes are compressed HTTP body bytes, excluding headers and TLS. They are site traffic, not measured Supabase billable egress.
Latency includes network, TLS/connection reuse, server response and local decompression/JSON parsing. Percentiles have small-sample uncertainty.
Request errors, stale data, unexpected identities or unprepared responses abort the remaining ramp; no automatic retries.

databaseObservations.source: Operator read-only SQL snapshots in approved production project vvkihuduqqnxqahhbphs
limitations: The SQL interval includes idle time and concurrent production background activity; the workload cannot be credited with every counter delta.
Connection counts are two point observations, not measured peak connections. No CPU or RAM saturation conclusion follows.
PostgreSQL block hits are distinct from CDN or Redis cache hits; these counters and storage sizes are not Supabase billing measurements.
